result.title: ViBMR: A Large-Scale Multi-Sequence Brain MRI Dataset and Comprehensive Evaluation for Vietnamese Radiology Report Generation
result.comment: Accepted at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)
result.summary: Automated radiology report generation for multi-sequence brain MRI holds strong promise for alleviating radiologists' workload, yet it remains a demanding problem: brain MRI studies are inherently volumetric, each pulse sequence carries complementary diagnostic information, and annotated data are critically scarce for low-resource clinical languages. Existing brain MRI-report resources are still dominated by English reports, translated clinical text, or datasets adapted from task-specific imaging benchmarks, leaving routine low-resource clinical reporting and heterogeneous multi-sequence MRI protocols insufficiently represented. To bridge this gap, we introduce ViBMR, to the best of our knowledge, the first large-scale multi-sequence brain MRI dataset paired with routine Vietnamese clinical reports, comprising 3,649 patients and 11,875 MRI series across T1, T2, FLAIR, and contrast-enhanced T1 sequences. Building on ViBMR, we establish a comprehensive evaluation setup for brain MRI report generation, covering representative medical vision-language models, multi-sequence inputs, and feature aggregation strategies. The results provide key insights into dataset characteristics and model behavior, while demonstrating the necessity of native low-resource clinical datasets for reliable Vietnamese-origin brain MRI report generation. Our dataset and baseline models will be released for non-commercial research.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建了越南语多序列脑部 MRI 报告生成数据集 ViBMR（3,649 名患者、11,875 个序列），并搭建了覆盖多种医学视觉语言模型、多序列输入与特征聚合策略的评测基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于低资源语言医学报告生成的数据集与刷分型基准，多序列特征聚合只是评测选项之一，未涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉证据筛选或停止决策等机制，缺乏可核查的具体借鉴线索。
